# WordSCR

> > WordSCR is an educational platform providing language learning resources, writing tools, and word analysis utilities for learners and professionals.

WordSCR combines practical writing and text analysis tools with comprehensive learning guides covering language, career development, and communication skills. The platform serves students, professionals, and language learners seeking to improve their writing, vocabulary, and multilingual communication abilities.

## Core Tools & Utilities

- [Character Counter](https://wordscr.com/character-counter): Character counter and text analysis tool for writing metrics
- [Page Count Calculator](https://wordscr.com/page-count): Page count calculator for word-to-page conversion and document formatting

## Learning & Educational Guides

- [Language Learning Guide](https://wordscr.com/language): Language learning guide covering multilingual communication and cultural heritage
- [Writing Guides](https://wordscr.com/writing): Writing guides for professional, creative, and job application content
- [How To Say - Multilingual Phrases](https://wordscr.com/how-to-say): Multilingual phrases, greetings, and expressions guide for communication
- [Interview Guide](https://wordscr.com/interview): Interview guide on communication skills with Dr. Marshall B. Rosenberg
- [CV & Resume Guide](https://wordscr.com/cv-resume): CV and resume writing guide with career advice and job search tips
